ai_services.name: QA OpenAI Service
ai_services.description: Shared LLM used by every QA agent in this app. Set a real api_key at import time (api_keys_json) or afterward in App Settings > AI Services.

agents.name: QA - Memory Chat
agents.description: Regression baseline: memory-enabled multi-turn conversation, summarization, and conversation reset. Unaffected code paths should behave exactly as before this branch.
agents.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant used for manual QA regression testing. Answer concisely and remember context from earlier in the conversation.

agents.name: QA - Stateless Chat
agents.description: Regression target for the conversation-ownership fix: memory-less (has_memory=false) agents previously let a client-supplied conversation_id through with NO ownership check, which keyed both the LangGraph session and (once code interpreter is on) the sandbox session. Use this agent to confirm an unowned/foreign conversation_id is now rejected with 404.
agents.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant used for manual QA regression testing. You have no persistent memory between messages.

agents.name: QA - Sandbox Code Interpreter
agents.description: Primary sandbox feature test agent (stateless). AFTER IMPORT: open this agent's form, check 'Code Interpreter', and pick a Sandbox Service (see the manual QA plan, Step 2) — enable_code_interpreter and sandbox_service_id are not part of the app-export format yet, so they can't be set by this import file.
agents.system_prompt: You are a data-analysis assistant with access to a Python/Bash code execution sandbox. Use the code interpreter tools to compute results, read/write files, and verify your answers whenever a task involves calculation, data processing, or file manipulation.

agents.name: QA - Sandbox + Memory
agents.description: Sandbox feature test agent with memory enabled, to cover the interaction between conversation memory and sandbox session persistence (both are keyed by the same conversation_id). AFTER IMPORT: enable Code Interpreter and attach a Sandbox Service, same as 'QA - Sandbox Code Interpreter'.
agents.system_prompt: You are a data-analysis assistant with access to a Python/Bash code execution sandbox and conversation memory. Remember files and variables from earlier in the conversation where possible, and say so explicitly if you cannot.
